messages.subject: Project Quartz — completion mechanics & funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We're targeting completion on Friday 8 May. Attached is the funds flow statement. Subscription monies (£8m Ravensworth, £2m Aldridge) to our client account by 11am Friday; net proceeds of £9,857,920 released to Larkmoor on satisfaction of the company's completion deliverables. Transaction costs of £142,080 are itemised.

Signature pages to me by Thursday close. Completion board meeting at 10am Friday.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0048
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
